'''Oum Sang-il'''  ({{Korean|hangul=엄상일}}; born 1976) is a South Korean mathematician working in [[graph theory]] and [[discrete mathematics]]. He is a distinguished research fellow and the chief investigator of the Discrete Mathematics Group in the Pioneer Research Center for Mathematical and Computational Sciences at the [[Institute for Basic Science]]. He was a tenured professor in the Department of Mathematical Sciences at [[KAIST]]. He is known for his work on structural graph theory and in particular for structures and algorithms relating to [[rank-width]], [[clique-width]], and branch-width. He published more than 80 journal papers.

He won the Young Scientist Award from the South Korean government in 2012.<ref>{{cite web |url= https://www.moe.go.kr/boardCnts/view.do?boardID=294&boardSeq=40074&lev=0&searchType=S&statusYN=C&page=348&s=moe&m=0302&opType= |script-title=ko:수학동아 "따끈따끈한 수학" 연재 (2019년) |date= 23 May 2020 |website= Korean Ministry of Education |access-date= 23 May 2020 |quote= |language= Korean}}</ref>
and the TJ Park Young Professor Fellowship<ref>{{cite web |url= https://www.postf.org/en/page/scien/scien_v.do |title= POSCO Science Fellowship |date= 23 May 2020 |website= POSCO TJ Park Foundation |access-date= 23 May 2020 |quote= }}</ref> from the POSCO TJ Park Foundation in 2009.
He has been an editor of ''Graphs and Combinatorics'', ''SIAM Journal on Computing'', and ''Journal of the Korean Mathematical Society'' and a founding member of Young Korean Academy of Science and Technology.

He wrote a monthly article for the monthly magazine ''{{ill|Math Donga|ko|수학동아}}'' for 4 years from 2016, sharing the latest research breakthroughs in mathematics.<ref>{{cite web |url= https://dimag.ibs.re.kr/home/sangil/2019/mathdonga-2019/ |script-title=ko:수학동아 "따끈따끈한 수학" 연재 (2019년) |last= Oum |first= Sang-il |date= 23 May 2020 |website= Sang-il Oum |access-date= 23 May 2020 |quote= |language= Korean}}</ref>

In the [[Korean Mathematical Society]], he was appointed twice (2011–2012, 2017–2018) as an executive member of the board of trustees in charge of the [[Korean Mathematical Olympiad]]. He was a member of the Korean Mathematical Olympiad Committee for 2011–2018 and was the deputy leader of the South Korean team at the [[International Mathematical Olympiad]] in 2012 and 2018.

==Education==
{{no refs|section|date=March 2026}}
Born in [[Yecheon County]], Oum attended [[Daegu Science High School]] in [[Daegu]] from 1992. He then went to [[KAIST]] where he majored in mathematics and graduated with a B.S. in 1998. Studying in the Program of Applied and Computational Mathematics of [[Princeton University]], he majored in graph theory and discrete mathematics. His dissertation was overseen by Professor [[Paul Seymour (mathematician)|Paul Seymour]] and Ph.D. was awarded in 2005.

==Career==
From 1999 to 2002, Oum worked as a computer programmer in Korea. 
He was a visiting assistant professor in the School of Mathematics, [[Georgia Tech]] for 2005–2006 and a postdoctoral fellow under [[Jim Geelen]] in the Department of Combinatorics & Optimization in the [[University of Waterloo]] in 2007. In 2008, he joined the Department of Mathematical Sciences [[KAIST]] as an assistant professor before coming an associate professor and then full professor in 2011 and 2016, respectively. He was an affiliate professor in the School of Mathematics, [[Korea Institute for Advanced Study]] for several years. In 2018, he was appointed as the CI (Chief Investigator) of the Discrete Mathematics Group in the Pioneer Research Center for Mathematical and Computational Sciences at the [[Institute for Basic Science]] (IBS). This and the Pioneer Research Center for Biomolecular and Cellular Structure are the first of two such centers at IBS.<ref>{{cite web |url= https://www.hankyung.com/it/article/2018120251041 |title= IBS, '젊은 연구자 주축' 연구단 출범 |last= 윤 |first= 희은 |date= 2 December 2018 |website=[[The Korea Economic Daily]] |publisher= |access-date= 20 January 2020 |quote= |language= Korean}}</ref><ref>{{cite web |url= http://www.dt.co.kr/contents.html?article_no=2018120202109931731004&ref=naver |title= IBS, 젊은 과학자 3명 주축 '새 연구단' 출범 |last= 이 |first= 준기 |date= 2 December 2018 |website= 디지털타임스 |publisher= The DigitalTimes. |access-date= 20 January 2020 |quote= |language= Korean}}</ref><ref>{{cite web |url= http://news1.kr/articles/?3491112 |title= IBS, 2개 연구단 새로 출범…30~40대 연구원 포진 |last= 남 |first= 도영 |date= 2 December 2018 |website=[[News1 (South Korean company)|News1]] |publisher= |access-date= 20 January 2020 |quote= |language= Korean}}</ref>

In 2023, Oum became a KAIST Endowed Chair Professor<!--(KAIST 지정석좌교수)--><ref>{{cite web |url= https://sangil.dimag.kr/awards/ |title= Awards |author= <!--Not stated--> |date= |website= Sang-il Oum |publisher= [[Perasonal website]] |access-date= 25 February 2026 |quote= |language= }}</ref> and the following year resigned from KAIST and became a Distinguished Research Fellow<!--수석연구위원--> at IBS.<ref>{{cite web |url=https://dimag.ibs.re.kr/members/ |title= Members |author= <!--Not stated--> |date= |website= Discrete Mathematics Group |publisher= [[Institute for Basic Science]] |access-date= 25 February 2026 |quote= |language= }}</ref><ref>{{cite web |url= https://sangil.dimag.kr/2024/resigned-from-kaist/ |title= Resigned from the professor position of KAIST |author= <!--Not stated--> |date= 11 August 2024 |website= Sang-il Oum |publisher= [[Personal website]] |access-date= 25 February 2026 |quote= |language= }}</ref>
